description: Source code for CPU feature detection specific to IBM z/Architecture (s390x) in the Go programming language, including facility checks and cryptographic capabilities.

methods.name: initOptions
methods.description: Initializes CPU feature options based on hardware facilities and cryptographic capabilities.

methods.name: bitIsSet
methods.description: Checks if a specific bit is set in a bit array.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if specified facilities or functions are present in the facility or function list.
